findings.highlight: blood gushes out from her mouth
findings.evidenceJa: こほっ、と赤いものが吐き出された
findings.governingReading: A small cough expels something red from Saber’s gasping mouth.
findings.explanation: Gushes greatly increases the volume and continuous force of the blood loss, removing the weak cough.

findings.highlight: I am fighting women and children
findings.evidenceJa: 相手は女子供だった
findings.governingReading: His opponent was a woman and a child—or contemptuously, a mere woman/child.
findings.explanation: Plural women and children invents groups and detaches the taunt from Saber and Shirou directly before him.

findings.highlight: there would have been infinite ways for me to fight by myself
findings.evidenceJa: 俺だけで戦う方法なんて、幾らでも、あった筈
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s self-reproach, there should have been any number of ways for him alone to fight.
findings.explanation: Infinite promotes guilt-driven counterfactual exaggeration into a mathematical claim.

findings.highlight: I could have made her run away
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーだけでも逃がせば良かった
findings.governingReading: He should at least have used the Command Spell to let Saber alone escape.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the minimum concession and Shirou’s willingness to remain behind alone.

findings.evidenceJa: それで気が付いたのか
findings.governingReading: Perhaps the approaching laughter made Saber regain awareness.
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s tentative causal reading into certainty.

findings.highlight: I can only move my arms
findings.evidenceJa: 体は腕しか動かない
findings.governingReading: Of his body, only one arm can move.
findings.explanation: The English makes both arms movable, contradicting the established one-arm injury state and the later right-hand-only passage.

findings.highlight: I can only call out to her and encourage her.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを元気づける言葉さえかけられない
findings.governingReading: He cannot even find words to encourage Saber.
findings.explanation: The English reverses inability into the only action Shirou can perform.

findings.evidenceJa: ぼんやりとした声
findings.governingReading: a dazed, unfocused voice
findings.explanation: Soft changes impaired consciousness into low volume or gentleness.

findings.evidenceJa: 不用意に一撃を受けて
findings.governingReading: after carelessly taking a single blow
findings.explanation: Sudden transfers the fault to attack timing; Shirou is condemning his own lack of caution.

findings.evidenceJa: こんな頭なんてなくていい
findings.governingReading: he has no need for a head like this
findings.explanation: Body broadens Shirou’s self-destructive rejection and breaks the transition from crushing his head to forcibly switching his mind into a magus.

findings.highlight: There never has been anyone I cared so much about.
findings.evidenceJa: これほど放っておけないヤツはいなかった
findings.governingReading: He has never encountered anyone he was so utterly unable to leave alone.
findings.explanation: Cared so much turns a compulsion to intervene into general emotional affection.

findings.highlight: I can hear sounds of metal.
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄の音がする
findings.governingReading: He hears the sound of iron.
findings.explanation: The English changes singular iron into plural generic metal sounds.

findings.evidenceJa: 鉄製の魔力
findings.governingReading: magical energy made of iron
findings.explanation: Metallic only describes a metal-like quality and weakens Shirou’s concrete declaration that the reinforcing magical power is iron-made.

findings.highlight: in the highest rotation from the start
findings.evidenceJa: 始めから最高速で
findings.governingReading: at maximum speed from the very start
findings.explanation: Highest rotation is nonidiomatic and turns speed into an unspecified rotational count.

findings.highlight: She must feel it even though she can’t see.
findings.evidenceJa: 見えずとも感じるのか
findings.governingReading: Can Saber sense what he is doing despite being unable to see it?
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s question about Saber’s perception into certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 最後の力が灯った
findings.governingReading: the last of Shirou’s strength kindles like a light
findings.explanation: Powers pluralizes 力 and “turn on” produces mechanical, nonidiomatic English that loses the ignition image.

findings.evidenceJa: 生き延びる為に水源へ走ろうとする行為
findings.governingReading: the act of a body set aflame trying to run toward a water source in order to survive
findings.explanation: The English removes survival as the purpose and makes Shirou externally “make” the body run rather than likening its motion to a desperate organism.

findings.evidenceJa: あんなセイバーの姿を見続けるより
findings.governingReading: continuing to look upon Saber in that ruined condition
findings.explanation: The English changes an ongoing unbearable sight into witnessing the initial injury event.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影、開始
findings.governingReading: “Projection, begin,” read aloud as “Trace on.”
findings.explanation: The English retains only the ruby incantation and removes the written command naming Projection and its commencement.

findings.highlight: I am imaging only one thing.
findings.evidenceJa: イメージするものはただ一つ
findings.governingReading: He images or visualizes only one thing.
findings.explanation: Imaging is a visible lexical typo for imagining and interrupts the projection sequence.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣を両手に握り
findings.governingReading: he grips the iron sword in both hands
findings.explanation: The English omits both the iron/steel ruby layer and the two-handed grip governing Shirou’s injured stance.

findings.evidenceJa: 竹刀より遙かに重い
findings.governingReading: far heavier than a bamboo practice sword
findings.explanation: The English drops the large degree separating the projected weapon from Shirou’s familiar training implement.

findings.evidenceJa: 四間
findings.governingReading: The interval is four ken, read as nine meters.
findings.explanation: mirror moon converts the written four ken directly into four meters, cutting the stated distance by more than half and discarding the ruby reading.

findings.evidenceJa: わずかに目を見張った後
findings.governingReading: after widening his eyes slightly
findings.explanation: The English changes a brief visible surprise into one second of observation.

findings.evidenceJa: うち下ろされた一撃
findings.governingReading: the blow brought down upon him
findings.explanation: Swung at me removes the downward trajectory of the opening strike.

findings.highlight: A sword with a long past
findings.evidenceJa: 長く戦い抜いた剣
findings.governingReading: a sword that has fought through long years of battle
findings.explanation: Long past replaces accumulated combat history with generic age.

findings.evidenceJa: この剣は既に把握していた
findings.governingReading: the sword had already grasped Gilgamesh’s sword paths
findings.explanation: The English leaves the sentence without an object or complete predicate, obscuring that the copied sword—not Shirou—understands the attacks.

findings.highlight: My fingers numb every time I swing
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を払う度に指先が痺れ
findings.governingReading: His fingertips go numb each time he beats aside an enemy blade.
findings.explanation: Swing removes the causal link between impact while parrying and accumulating numbness.

findings.highlight: He must dislike even the slight resistance.
findings.evidenceJa: 一時の抵抗すら許せないのか
findings.governingReading: Can he not tolerate even a moment’s resistance?
findings.explanation: Dislike weakens furious intolerance, changes duration to degree, and promotes Shirou’s question into certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 助かった
findings.governingReading: That pause saved him; he feels stark relief.
findings.explanation: Thank God adds a religious invocation absent from Shirou’s internal voice.

findings.evidenceJa: この剣の、原型
findings.governingReading: the prototype of this sword
findings.explanation: Model again misstates the originating weapon as a representation or design exemplar.

findings.highlight: its strength as a Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具としての精度
findings.governingReading: its degree of refinement or precision as a Noble Phantasm
findings.explanation: Strength substitutes raw power for fidelity, quality, or refinement in the prototype-copy comparison.

findings.highlight: It must be protecting its owner.
findings.evidenceJa: 主を守る為か
findings.governingReading: Is the sword acting to protect its wielder?
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s inference about the copied sword’s autonomous response into certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 自ら敵の剣へ奔る
findings.governingReading: races of its own accord toward the enemy blade
findings.explanation: The English omits the sword’s autonomous action, central to the inherited-memory mechanic.

findings.evidenceJa: 風に飛ばされたゴミのように路面を転がり
findings.governingReading: he tumbles across the pavement like trash blown by the wind
findings.explanation: The English removes the degrading simile, the paved surface, and rolling motion.

findings.highlight: It seems my body has been injured.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷を負ったのは胴体らしい
findings.governingReading: The injury appears to be in his torso.
findings.explanation: Body removes the location that prepares the diagonal shoulder-to-waist wound reveal.

findings.highlight: my left shoulder isn’t attached to my body. I don’t know what has happened to it.
findings.evidenceJa: 左手がどうなっているのかも判らない
findings.governingReading: He cannot tell what has happened to his left hand or arm.
findings.explanation: The active English contains an abandoned variant explicitly detaching Shirou’s shoulder, then retains the source-faithful uncertainty.

findings.highlight: lego pieces that don’t fit together
findings.evidenceJa: かみ合わない積み木
findings.governingReading: misaligned building blocks that no longer fit together
findings.explanation: Lego adds a modern brand and toy-specific texture to a stark body-separation simile.

findings.evidenceJa: 我ながら不気味なぐらい
findings.governingReading: Even to Shirou, remaining alive is eerie or uncanny.
findings.explanation: Strange weakens the horror and self-alienation of surviving such bodily division.

findings.evidenceJa: 中身がごっそりこぼれ落ちる
findings.governingReading: his insides will spill out wholesale in a mass
findings.explanation: The English removes the total, scooping quantity of the threatened evisceration.

findings.evidenceJa: 消えていく意識が、しっかりと体にしがみつく
findings.governingReading: his fading consciousness clings tightly to his body
findings.explanation: The English erases the paradoxical embodied image and the fact that consciousness is already fading.
